method: Reviewed new 1fps candidate sheets spanning 0-24 seconds, then extracted exact timestamps below from originals at 1080x1920 and inspected selected-frame contact sheets. Frames are unchanged video extracts; no product generation, compositing, crop, retouch or upload.
common_limits: These are owner creative frames, not independently verified physical sample photographs.
No selected frame includes Cash on Delivery wording or the final offer/end card.
Many selected frames retain subtitles and sparkle/diamond marks from the original; preserve provenance. Subtitle claims remain creative claims, not verified catalog specifications.
Six selected timestamps are not six unique camera setups. Similar closeups are explicitly noted. None of the selected hero frames establishes battery, materials, load ratings or clinical performance.
